item.title: The TDCC App: console, CLI, SDKs, and job API enter early access
item.description: The TDCC App is the product surface of the compute network: submit training, fine-tuning, inference, and evaluation jobs through a console, CLI, Python/TypeScript SDKs, or REST API. Jobs are matched to suitable hardware, run in approved isolated runtimes, verified against acceptance criteria, and billed only when accepted. Rolling out in staged early-access cohorts with the pilot network.
